operative_context: ## 2.1.1 The system shall allow authenticated users to create a rent request for an available rentable item.
Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
The system shall maintain the full lifecycle history of each rent record
exceptions: The system shall allow authorized users to cancel rent records that are in Approved or Active status
The system shall allow authorized users to manually trigger rent completion for early returns
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier lifecycle guidance may have included a tolerance window for early operator cancellation that waived penalty fees, but this exemption language is not present in the current specification and its status is unclear
